verdict.rationale: Statsig documents an official CLI for managing Feature Gates, Experiments, and Dynamic Configs, and says it can be integrated into CI/CD pipelines for automation; a probe confirms the official CLI docs page exists. The evidence is limited to an introduction page. missing for 10: documented command reference/depth, AI-native or agent-oriented features (e.g., JSON output, non-interactive auth), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The Statsig CLI is a command-line interface that helps manage Feature Gates, Experiments, and Dynamic Configs within the Statsig platform.
You can integrate the CLI into CI/CD pipelines to automate the management of Feature Gates and Experiments.
